items.description: F1 (major, budget): enrich-before-ingest persists no step-2 match outcome, so every later SKILL fence that needs `classified` re-runs `preingest.match_batch` and re-POSTs the whole batch in propose mode (UAT 2026-09-11, run a254d1eda71246a2a964922cdf5c2bd2: six 4-row sends 12365/12366/12368/12370/12373/12374 + two 2-row sends 12375/12376). Persist the step-2 match outcome per run_id in the plugin durable state dir and make every later fence in operator-claude-plugin/skills/enrich-before-ingest/SKILL.md load it instead of re-matching; test against the recorded shape. See .planning/UAT-autonomous-batch-2026-09-09.md F1.

F9 (major, AFTER-01): the end-of-run report line "Matches the original batch's N row(s)" is scoped by SKILL.md line 1139 to len(unmatched_rows) and reads as false against a 4-row input; rename the scope line so it names this run's enrichment scope, and persist the matched-id handoff (confirmed_ids to enrich-records) per run_id as a durable file the report names. See .planning/UAT-autonomous-batch-2026-09-09.md F9.

F11 (minor): operator-claude-plugin/skills/enrich-before-ingest/SKILL.md has no write_grant.close_grant step; add the batch-complete close (CLOSED_BATCH_COMPLETE) at end of run and CLOSED_SESSION_END guidance. See .planning/UAT-autonomous-batch-2026-09-09.md F11.

F10 (major, cost model): grant pricing and preview_enrichment price Lusha at 1 credit per contact; execution 12372 Lusha Enrich billing block shows creditsCharged 7 for one rich reveal (balance 3860 to 3853 confirmed) and 0 for NOT_FOUND. Re-measure the Lusha rate the pricing table uses and record the 7-credit observation in docs/LUSHA-V3-CONTRACT.md. Bump operator-claude-plugin to 0.46.0 with one CHANGELOG section naming F1/F9/F10/F11. See .planning/UAT-autonomous-batch-2026-09-09.md F10.
